notifyAgentReply.reason: The bounded branch owns its outputs from the start (the application user read needs an owner), declares the reply (anchor kind, resource and the creator/prompter/coding-subscriber audience) and keeps the literal callback and scopes; the off path is literal. Issues run on the issue-record point writer with mutateIssueScope's preimage (locked issue, all issue content, live agent role with the inactive-member refusal, no previous values); documents and projects run on the resource-scope image writer with mutateScoped's (resource content, actor substitution, the agent's teams, previous values). Both select the anchor, its thread subscriptions, complete records, preferences and push subscriptions of the audience (declared users plus thread participants), the target SLAs and team timezone, and for documents the access inputs of documentRoleFor; notifications and deliveries are the only admitted edits, each addressed to that audience. TestScaleP21AgentReplyNotificationsDifferential compares legacy, warm and SQL-reloaded runs (narrow inputs on and off) for issue, document and project replies and questions: new and refreshed notifications (issue key, legacy session key, read/archived reset, occurrence count), generated delivery replacement, digest timing and urgency, muted threads, app, former-member and no-access recipients, a missing anchor and an inactive agent. Persistent SQLite twice and race pass with zero full decodes and released work.
